title: Stale Active Directory accounts
pitch: List the accounts nobody uses, then lay the month's password expiries and the disable date on a calendar.
makeItYours: Fill the account rows from Get-ADUser with LastLogonDate, PasswordLastSet and msDS-UserPasswordExpiryTimeComputed.
Change the 60-day, 90-day and one-year rules to match your account policy.
Exclude service accounts you manage elsewhere, or give them their own panel.
useCase: Use it when the quarterly access review needs the inactive accounts and the next month's expiries in one place.
